rundir.description: Directory where the KNOT daemon stores runtime files (e.g., PID file).

server_user.description: User and group under which the Knot DNS server runs.

automatic_acl.description: Enable automatic ACLs for local addresses. Set to 'on' or 'off'.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. Choose from: critical, error, warning, notice, info, debug.

database_storage.description: Directory where the Knot DNS database is stored.

template_storage.description: Directory where zone files for default templates are stored.
